items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Because I worked with Frank Sinatra making records in 1948, I believe

ctx.x: Because I worked with Frank Sinatra making records in 1948, I believe, and he made a record he was so desperate to try to make something that went, he made a record with the Fillmore Four and One More and had -- made a tune called 'Bop Goes My Heart,' if you would believe that.
